---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new, real capability or improvement within an existing capability's approved scope
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem statement

What real business or engineering problem does this solve? (Per the Capability Governance Standard, a capability is justified by a real business problem, never by the availability of an interesting technology.)

## Proposed solution

Describe the change. If this touches a capability under active governance (e.g. DGX 2.0 Demand Forecasting), confirm it stays within that capability's approved scope — see `docs/capabilities/` and the relevant frozen baseline before proposing scope expansion.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you consider, and why is this the preferred approach?

## Is this in scope for the current phase?

- [ ] Yes — this fits within an already-approved capability's current scope.
- [ ] No — this would expand scope beyond what's currently approved (if so, consider an [Architecture Proposal](architecture_proposal.md) instead).

## Additional context

Links to related issues, discussions, or documentation.
